title: Esos leads no sirven, jefe: el dueño que apagó la pauta (Serie Sala de Juntas, video 19)

ia.dice: Jefe, como asesor inmobiliario se lo digo: esos leads de Facebook no sirven. Pura gente que no compra.
ia.prompt: Vertical 9:16 video. Stylized 3D animated cartoon with exaggerated caricature proportions, like a modern animated comedy film. Daytime, a busy modern real estate agency office with desks and property posters. Kevin, a chubby young Mexican real estate agent in his twenties with spiky gelled hair, a wrinkled light blue shirt and a crooked tie, slouches bored at his desk, spinning in his chair, talks to his boss off-screen with a yawn and says in Mexican Spanish, bored and lazy: "Jefe, como asesor inmobiliario se lo digo: esos leads de Facebook no sirven. Pura gente que no compra." Medium close-up, static camera. Audio: only his voice in Spanish, office ambience. No music. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

ia.dice: Ya ni modo. Si mis asesores dicen que no sirven… apaguen la pauta.
ia.prompt: Vertical 9:16 video. Stylized 3D animated cartoon with exaggerated caricature proportions, like a modern animated comedy film. Daytime, the owner's office of a real estate agency. Don Ramiro, the owner of a real estate agency, a short chubby Mexican man in his fifties with a thick black mustache, receding hairline, white shirt with rolled-up sleeves and a loose red tie, sits at his desk talking on the phone, sighs, defeated, rubs his forehead and says in Mexican Spanish, tired and resigned: "Ya ni modo. Si mis asesores dicen que no sirven… apaguen la pauta." Medium close-up, static camera. Audio: only his voice in Spanish, office ambience. No music. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

ia.dice: Don Carlos, ¿cómo va? Le tengo el departamento que me pidió… sí, por fuera, tranquilo.
ia.prompt: Vertical 9:16 video. Stylized 3D animated cartoon with exaggerated caricature proportions, like a modern animated comedy film. Daytime, inside a parked car right outside a real estate agency office with a big "AGENCIA INMOBILIARIA" sign. Kevin, a chubby young Mexican real estate agent in his twenties with spiky gelled hair, a wrinkled light blue shirt and a crooked tie, sits in the driver seat holding the phone to his ear, super happy and energetic, then winks at the camera and says in Mexican Spanish, cheerful and friendly, the last words whispered: "Don Carlos, ¿cómo va? Le tengo el departamento que me pidió… sí, por fuera, tranquilo." Medium close-up, static camera. Audio: only his voice in Spanish, quiet street ambience. No music. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

scenes.text: Si tu asesor dice que los leads no sirven, no tienes cómo comprobarlo. Y a lo mejor sí sirven… pero para él.
Lead Master se conecta al WhatsApp y a las llamadas de tus asesores y vendedores, y en automático te dice qué pasó con cada lead. Todos los días te llega el reporte, sin que nadie llene nada.
